company.name: Keeperz
company.shortDescription: Online Marketplace, Food-tech, Dine-in & Takeaway Discounts, Cashback Rewards, Digital Word-of-Mouth, Wallet Payment, Loyalty Programs
company.description:
Keeperz founders started their journey in 2019 by building one of the most active community of foodies in UAE, comprising tens of thousands of food-geeks and micro-influencers who are always on the hunt for a pleasant dining experience, and they are also obsessed with sharing these experiences with their families, friends and fellow community members. 

The founders developed Keeperz app as a foodies platform that connects local restaurants to their foodies community members.

On one hand, Keeperz app provides its users-community with a smarter way: to explore new pleasant dining experiences, enjoy attractive discount on their dine-in & takeaway bills at their popular restaurants, inspire their peers by sharing their authentic experiences and earn handsome cashback rewards for their loyalty & shared experience. Flexible Rewards can be redeemed at any Keeperz partner merchants.

On the other hand, Keeperz app empowers its partner restaurants with an all-in-one marketing solution that allows them to run tailored promotional campaigns that perfectly matches their exact business needs and address their own pains & gains towards profit maximization. 

Keeperz app is equipped with all marketing tools & techniques necessary to allow restaurants to: organically acquire new customers, enhance customer loyalty, increase average bill size and achieve optimal capacity utilization.
The apps USP the recommendation feature that digitizes the “word of mouth”, by giving voice to restaurants’ happy consumers to become their brand ambassadors, bringing many new customers through the door and stimulating sustainable organic growth. 
The merchants pay a recurring platform subscription fee and a per-transaction charge for the business that Keeperz drives to them.
